help_text:
🤖 **Complete Bot Guide:**

You can use the bot using the following commands:

🔹 **Main Commands:**
• /start - Start the bot and register
• /help - Help and command list
• /language - Change bot language (UZ, RU, EN, TG)

💰 **Account & Documents:**
• /balans - Check your balance and points
• /buy - Top up balance and purchases
• /ai - Chat with Artificial Intelligence
• /create_cv - Create a CV / reference
• /create_cv2 - Create a personal sheet

👑 **Admin Commands:**
• /admin - Bot statistics and management panel

For questions and support: @Parviz_shdpi
